green.message_contract: job_id, epoch and contract version only

local_verification.ruff: 158 files passed lint and format checks
local_verification.dependency_audit: no known Python vulnerabilities; production frontend audit 0
local_verification.frontend: OpenAPI/UmiOpenAPI contract, boundary, negative boundary, Prettier and TypeScript/Vite checks passed with no generated diff

limitations: The collection pages and source admission are synthetic and do not establish a live platform capability.
The existing MinIO instance was not used; evidence persistence was verified with the in-memory adapter and existing object protocol tests.
The MVP intentionally samples at most two root pages and one reply root with at most two reply pages; broader multi-root coverage remains open.
This slice does not complete real-source admission, production model taxonomy, old-application rollback or seven-day observation.
